README.md:1:# Settings client
README.md:2:
README.md:3:Python 3.9+, standard library only. Tests: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
README.md:4:The client and provider ship independently. Every merged client increment must
README.md:5:support the released provider at Git tag `eval-release`, including ordinary
README.md:6:settings saves while enhanced_settings is false. `provider/settings.py` at that
README.md:7:tag is the supported provider source. Provider sources moved out of this
README.md:8:checkout after that release; local Git retains the release snapshot.
README.md:9:A successful settings save means values were applied and the caller sees success.
README.md:10:The candidate provider is not deployed and a pending provider task cannot change
README.md:11:the supported baseline. No live environment is available or required here.
